recipes.name: Pumpkin French Toast Bake
ingredients_raw: 1 loaf Texas toast thick-sliced bread, cut into 1-inch cubes

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Whisk eggs, white sugar, vanilla extract, 2 teaspoons of cinnamon, vanilla extract, cloves, and nutmeg together in a bowl; beat in pumpkin until fully incorporated.
Arrange bread cubes in a single layer in the prepared baking dish; pour pumpkin mixture over bread cubes, and gently toss to coat.
Stir 1/3 cup of brown sugar, 1/4 teaspoon of cinnamon, flour, and butter together with a fork in a small bowl until the mixture is crumbly; sprinkle over bread cubes.
Bake in preheated oven until golden brown on top, 30 to 40 minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Pumpkin French Toast Bake
raw_recipe.description: This pumpkin French toast casserole flavored with fall spices is a delicious breakfast indulgence, perfect for the holidays or any Saturday morning!

review.reviewBody: This was a really great addition to a brunch menu. It was perfectly spiced and not too sweet, but just sweet enough to not need syrup. The crumb topping is an extra special touch. I found I liked it best with just a dollop of fresh whipped cream to complement the spicy pumpkin flavor. I didn't have Texas toast and substituted a loaf of regular sandwich bread, which when cubed equaled about 8 cups. I also took the crusts off first. The only minor issue was with mixing everything in the baking dish - that caused it to stick to the dish. I would recommend stirring the pumpkin mixture in a large bowl and adding the bread cubes to the bowl to mix, then pouring it all in the baking pan.

Love this recipe! I never buy white bread, so I used whole grain bread that we had on hand. Chopped up 8-9 cups as recommended by another reviewer. I also added 3/4 cup of apple sauce to the pumpkin mix since whole grain bread tends to have more substance (stuff to get wet) than white bread. Also I added an extra teaspoon of cinnamon because, yum. As per other recommendations, I moved everything in the bowl before dumping into the casserole dish. Cooked for 30 min, since it was impossible to tell if it was browned between the whole grain bread and extra cinnamon, but it was perfect. Served with maple syrup! This stuff was amazing, a delightful seasonal change of pace.

Made this recipe after breakfast, to use up the pumpkin purée in the fridge, so let it soak up the goodness; baked it just before the new episode of "Revenge," and served it drizzled with Hungry Jack butter Syrup, a dollop of KoolWhip, and lots of crisp bacon! I love the pumpkin in it, and the spices scented the whole house! I halved the recipe; used a tad more spices, let it sit in the fridge 6 hours, and baked it in a brownie pan lined with nonstick foil.

Made this with the Cinnamon Swirl bread from Trader Joe's. Excellent!! One loaf is perfect for a 9x9 pan. I cut back by 3 eggs and a little on the spices since it's a smaller size than the Texas toast loaf. Made topping with extra butter. Sprinkle of brown sugar or turbinado sugar on top gives it a nice crispy texture. A drizzle of bourbon barrel maple syrup just before serving was the perfect touch. I feel sorry for my gluten free friends..
I substituted Splenda Brown Sugar Blend for the brown sugar and sprinkled Pumpkin Pie Spice on top before baking.

Made this for guests at my B&B. They LOVED it! It was light and not too sweet. I served it with maple syrup on the side, but no one used it. I altered the recipe a bit. I cut the bread up smaller, to fill the pyrex pan, and increased the eggs to 10. There didn't seem like enough "batter" so I added 3/4 cup of milk. It came out great and is definitely on our fall roster of sweet entrees.

I made a few changes. My husband is diabetic so I used Swerve granular instead of white sugar. For the topping I used granular Boca Sweet instead of brown sugar. I made it with Challah bread for a bit more flavor and added 1cup of whole milk to the pumpkin mixture to avoid it being too dry! Oh yeah / also added a bag of chopped pecans!! Delicious!!

This was awesome, I did make some changes based on other reviewers. Added more spices (used pumpkin spice vs individual spices) to the pumpkin mixture, at least a couple more teaspoons of pumpkin spice. Also we like sweetness so I added a spoon or two more sugar/brown sugar and with the topping I mixed extra brown sugar with a pack of maple and brown sugar oatmeal and a spoon of flour. Mixed it with the butter until crumble and it made an incredible topping. This was a filling, delicious breakfast treat and the kids especially loved it.

I make this for my summer camp kids and they love it! I love sneaking vegetables into things so the pumpkin is great, and to make it more healthy I use whole wheat bread. I double the recipe and put it in a short steam table pan. This also has enough eggs that it is more substantial protein-wise than just pancakes and easier to make for a crowd than french toast. The last time I made it I had to use cartons of egg whites because my supplier hasn't had eggs in several weeks and I also covered it to prevent the edges & top from burning and it was even better- more moist and not so heavy. I'll be doing it that way again!

I couldn't find Texas Toast without any butter so used plain Frech bread. I didnt see Carmel topping until I watched the video so I added that to the top but only half with and half without. If anyone else wanted it, it could be easier to add than take off. I used a large bowl to mix everything up then put in the 9x13. I might add like Walnuts to the top the next time I make it.

I had a few issues with this recipe. First of all, there is no way that an entire loaf of Texas toast fits in just one layer of a 9x13 pan. Also, there is not enough liquid in this recipe. The pumpkin mixture was so thick that it did not soak into the bread. You need to add milk to the mixture before pouring it onto the bread so it actually soaks in.
Every one ate this breakfast for dinner meal . This was definitely very sweat. I paired it with bacon and eggs but next time some ham would be great . I used thick sliced Italian bread instead .
the bread was very dry, as if not enough liquid. Would be helpful to have accurate measurement of bread cubes, such as 2 cups, etc. Was disappointing.

What a great way to add a vegetable to breakfast!! I have made this for kids at camp and school and everyone loves it! I use whole wheat bread and no one can even tell with the pumpkin. Great nutrition profile with whole grain, vegetable and protein. Have also done with Schar gluten free bread and it runs out great as well.
Absolutely loved this!!! I threw some pecans on top before putting it in the oven. So good!!

Added a bit more white sugar not quite sweet enough for my family, also like another cook I added some milk to aid in the absorption. Really liked the rich pumpkin taste. Glad to find a simple and quick to prepare pumpkin recipe. https://linktr.ee/aliceewake
